layout.title: Teacher's Private Platform
layout.description: A private educational platform: courses, lessons, students, enrollments, quizzes, and files.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your account
login.tagline: Learning, teaching, and progress — all in one place.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link
forgotPassword.tagline: We'll help you get back into your account safely.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account
resetPassword.tagline: Choose a strong password to keep your account secure.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule

schedule.formSubtitle: Create or update a recurring session.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Create and manage the courses you teach.

courses.formSubtitle: Course details are shown to students in both languages.

lessons.subtitle: Add, edit, and reorder the lessons in this course.

lessons.formSubtitle: Lesson details are shown to students in both languages.

lessons.deleteConfirmDescription: This removes the lesson from the course. This can't be undone.

errors.reorder: Could not save the new order.

files.title: Files

errors.tooLarge: This file is too large (max 20 MB).

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Create student accounts for your classes.
students.formSubtitle: The student gets a one-time link to set their own password — nothing is emailed automatically yet.
